create.name: Donald Altman
create.bio:
Donald Altman is a writer and teacher of mindfulness who spent time as a Buddhist monk before training as a counsellor. He has written more than twenty books and audio programmes on the subject, translated into several languages, and he is known for turning traditional practice, including the Buddhist four foundations of mindfulness, into short exercises people can use at home, at work and in their relationships. He once served as an officer of The Center for Mindful Eating, taught for years as an adjunct at Portland State University and Lewis & Clark, and has been profiled in a mindfulness documentary and in the Living Spiritual Teachers Project.

His books range from Living Kindness, a reflection on ten principles the Buddha set out for a good life, to practical handbooks such as One-Minute Mindfulness and The Joy Compass. In recent years he has built the Simply Mindful series: a seven-week course and handbook for learning or teaching mindfulness, a book of daily reflections with journalling prompts, and a collection of one-page practices for steadiness and optimism. He blogs regularly on practical mindfulness for Psychology Today, co-hosts the Pathways radio programme and podcast of interviews with spiritual and cultural figures, and leads workshops for the public and for professionals in health care and business.

books.title: Living Kindness: The Buddha's Ten Guiding Principles for a Blessed Life
books.author: Donald Altman
books.description: A reflection on ten principles from the Buddha's teaching, among them generosity, patience, truthfulness and loving-kindness. Through stories he shows how similar values appear across the world's religions and how they can shape daily conduct.

books.title: Simply Mindful: A 7-Week Course and Personal Handbook for Mindful Living
books.author: Donald Altman
books.description: A structured seven-week curriculum for learning mindfulness or teaching it to others. It covers the traditional four foundations alongside modern approaches, with more than thirty practices from breath awareness to loving-kindness.

books.title: One-Minute Mindfulness: 50 Simple Ways to Find Peace, Clarity, and New Possibilities in a Stressed-Out World
books.author: Donald Altman
books.description: Fifty short exercises for bringing attention back to the present in the middle of ordinary life, from work and family to meals and routines.

books.title: The Joy Compass: 8 Ways to Find Lasting Happiness, Gratitude & Optimism in the Present Moment
books.author: Donald Altman
books.description: A pocket guide to eight routes back to joy, including gratitude, forgiveness, laughter, music, meditation and connection with others.

books.title: Simply Mindful Reflections: 101 Daily Reflections for Joy, Hope & Healing
books.author: Donald Altman
books.description: A book of 101 short reflections grouped around themes such as simplicity, nature, love and wisdom. Each is followed by three questions for journalling and quiet reflection.

books.title: Simply Mindful Resilience: Cultivate Calm, Clarity, Optimism & Happiness Each Day
books.author: Donald Altman
books.description: A hundred and one one-page practices arranged around four sources of resilience: calm, clarity, optimism and connection with others.
